---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible repository, plugin contract, or documentation defect
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

Describe the observed behavior and the expected behavior.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest reproducible inputs, commands, files, or fixture details that do not contain secrets.

## Scope

Which plugin, repository contract, documentation surface, or workflow is affected?

## Evidence

Include relevant validator/test/CI output and environment/runtime information when available.

## Security-sensitive reports

If this may expose credentials, bypass an approval/safety boundary, enable prompt-injection-driven writes, or otherwise be security-sensitive, follow [`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md). Do **not** publish exploit details, secrets, tokens, or sensitive account data in a public issue.
